errors.evidence: The labeled ticks on the x-axis are at 1, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30. The interval between these labeled ticks is not uniformly 1.
The line style is dashed, not solid ('实线').
The markers are blue circles from Epoch 1 to 5, and then switch to blue stars from Epoch 5 onwards. The description incorrectly states all markers are stars.

errors.text_span: 表示学习率随Epoch的下降趋势
errors.evidence: The description inaccurately characterizes the trend as only decreasing. The plot shows a sharp increase in the learning rate from Epoch 1 to a peak at Epoch 5, followed by a decrease.
At Epoch 1, the learning rate shown on the plot is exactly 0.0002, not approximately 0.0004.
At Epoch 5, the learning rate reaches its peak value of exactly 0.0010, not approximately 0.0003.
At Epoch 15, the learning rate shown on the plot is exactly 0.0008, not approximately 0.0002.
At Epoch 30, the learning rate is very close to 0.0000, not approximately 0.0001.
The description fails to mention the peak of the learning rate, which occurs at Epoch 5 with a value of 0.0010. The prompt specifically asks to note any peaks.
